title: 短いダクト付き可搬換気送風機
titleEn: Portable ventilation blower with short duct
description: 可搬式ドラム型送風機の静的モデル。中空シュラウド、同心円状グリル、6枚の固定羽根、持ち手付き防振フレームと短い中空フレキシブルダクトを備えます。長いダクト、電源、送風・換気動作は付属しません。閉鎖空間での使用適合性や安全性能を保証しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.648 × 0.763 × 1.100 m、24,804三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static portable drum ventilation blower with hollow shroud, concentric open grille, six fixed fan blades, isolated carry frame and a short hollow flexible duct. Long duct runs, power supply, airflow and ventilation behavior are absent. It does not claim confined-space suitability or validated safety performance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.648 × 0.763 × 1.100 m; 24,804 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
